nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) balances in StdToken; tracks token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) allowed in StdToken; tracks allowances.
uint public totalSupply in StdToken; total token supply.
bool public lockTransfers in MNTP; locks transfers when true.
address public creator in MNTP; creator account.
address public icoContractAddress in MNTP; ICO contract address.
uint64 public icoIsFinishedDate in GoldmintUnsold; timestamp when ICO finished.
uint64 public lastWithdrawTime in FoundersVesting; last withdraw timestamp.
uint public withdrawsCount in FoundersVesting; number of withdrawals.
uint public amountToSend in FoundersVesting; amount to transfer per withdrawal.
uint public icoTokensSold in Goldmint; tokens sold during ICO.
uint public icoTokensUnsold in Goldmint; unsold tokens moved after ICO.
uint public issuedExternallyTokens in Goldmint; tokens issued externally.
mapping(address=>TokenBuyer) buyers in Goldmint; records wei sent and tokens got.
State public currentState in Goldmint; ICO state machine.
uint64 public icoStartedTime in Goldmint; ICO start timestamp.
bool public foundersRewardsMinted in Goldmint; tracks founder reward minting.
bool public restTokensMoved in Goldmint; tracks unsold token move.
address public multisigAddress in Goldmint; receives ETH.
address public tokenManager in Goldmint; can issue external tokens.
address public otherCurrenciesChecker in Goldmint; can issue from other currencies.
MNTP public mntToken in Goldmint; token contract reference.
GoldmintUnsold public unsoldContract in Goldmint; unsold token contract.
address public foundersRewardsAccount in Goldmint; founder vesting account.
function SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) internal returns (uint); uses assert to prevent overflow.
function SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) internal returns (uint); uses assert to prevent underflow.
function SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) internal returns (uint); uses assert to prevent overflow.
function StdToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) returns (bool); transfers tokens.
function StdToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) returns (bool); transfers with allowance.
function StdToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) returns (bool); sets allowance.
function StdToken.balanceOf(address _owner) constant returns (uint256); returns balance.
function StdToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant returns (uint256); returns remaining allowance.
function MNTP.issueTokens(address _who, uint _tokens) byCreatorOrIcoContract; issues tokens.
function MNTP.burnTokens(address _who, uint _tokens) byCreatorOrIcoContract; burns tokens.
function MNTP.lockTransfer(bool _lock) byCreatorOrIcoContract; locks/unlocks transfers.
function MNTP.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); override with lock check.
function MNTP.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); override with lock check.
function GoldmintUnsold.finishIco() public onlyIcoContract; records finish timestamp.
function GoldmintUnsold.withdrawTokens() public; waits one year then transfers tokens.
function FoundersVesting.withdrawTokens() public; monthly withdrawal of 1/10 tokens.
function Goldmint.setState(State _nextState) public; controls ICO state machine.
function Goldmint.buyTokens(address _buyer) public payable onlyInState(State.ICORunning); buys tokens.
function Goldmint.issueTokensInternal(address _to, uint _tokens) internal; issues tokens and updates icoTokensSold.
function Goldmint.issueTokensExternal(address _to, uint _tokens) public onlyInState(State.ICOFinished) onlyTokenManager; issues bonus tokens.
function Goldmint.issueTokensFromOtherCurrency(address _to, uint _wei_count) public onlyInState(State.ICORunning) onlyOtherCurrenciesChecker.
function Goldmint.burnTokens(address _from, uint _tokens) public onlyInState(State.ICOFinished) onlyTokenManager; burns tokens.
function Goldmint.getMyRefund() public onlyInState(State.Refunding); refunds ETH and burns tokens.
function Goldmint.finishICO() internal; unlocks transfers, moves unsold tokens, sends ETH.
function Goldmint.startICO() internal onlyCreator; mints founder rewards and locks transfers.
function Goldmint.mintFoundersRewards(address _whereToMint) internal onlyCreator; mints founder rewards once.
function Goldmint.getMntTokensPerEth(uint tokensSold) public constant returns (uint); computes token price.
function Goldmint.isIcoFinished() public returns(bool); checks time and sold tokens.

icoTokensSold += _tokens direct addition without SafeMath in issueTokensInternal.
issuedExternallyTokens = issuedExternallyTokens + _tokens direct addition in issueTokensExternal.
